source: Written 2026-10-14 from the verified oracle text (Scryfall, fetched 2026-10-14), Scryfall's rulings for Tifa, Martial Artist (2025-06-06) and Annie Joins Up (2024-04-12), CR 500.8, 613.4b-c and 903.10a, and this deck's notes. Printed power/toughness comes from the cached Scryfall card data. Terrian, World Tyrant's oracle text came back empty, so only its cost and printed 9/7 are used. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named.

scenes.head: Tifa, Martial Artist — Seventh Heaven
scenes.sub: Red, green and white. Get a creature to power 7, hit a player with it, then untap and fight again.
scenes.say: Tifa, Martial Artist. Seventh Heaven. A red, green and white deck: get a creature to power seven, hit a player with it, then untap and fight again.

scenes.head: Melee: she grows when she attacks
scenes.sub: Whenever Tifa attacks, she gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat. She starts as a 4/4.
scenes.say: Melee: she grows when she attacks. Whenever Tifa attacks, she gets plus one plus one until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat. She starts as a four-four.

scenes.head: Attack all three opponents: a 7/7
scenes.sub: Melee counts opponents, not creatures. Tifa attacks one; [[Red XIII, Proud Warrior|Red XIII]] and [[Professional Face-Breaker|Face-Breaker]] attack the other two. That's +3/+3.
scenes.say: Attack all three opponents, and she's a seven-seven. Melee counts opponents, not creatures. Tifa attacks one, and [[Red XIII, Proud Warrior|Red Thirteen]] and [[Professional Face-Breaker|Face-Breaker]] attack the other two. That's plus three plus three.

scenes.head: Power 7 connects: untap and fight again
scenes.sub: Whenever creatures you control with power 7 or greater deal combat damage to a player, untap all creatures you control. In your first combat, another combat follows.
scenes.say: Power seven connects: untap and fight again. When creatures you control with power seven or greater deal combat damage to a player, untap all your creatures. In your first combat, another combat follows.

scenes.head: Get to seven. Connect. Fight again.
scenes.sub: Four clips follow: reaching power 7, big bodies that draw cards, [[Annie Joins Up]]'s three combats, and how the deck wins.
scenes.say: Get to seven. Connect. Fight again. Four clips follow: reaching power seven, the big bodies that draw cards, [[Annie Joins Up]] and its three combats, and how the deck wins.

scenes.head: +2/+2, and one opponent is enough
scenes.sub: [[Bastion Protector]]: commander creatures you control get +2/+2 and indestructible. [[Champion's Helm]]: +2/+2, and hexproof on a legend. Tifa is 6/6; one opponent makes her 7/7.
scenes.say: Plus two plus two: one opponent is enough. [[Bastion Protector]] gives your commander plus two plus two and indestructible. [[Champion's Helm]] gives plus two plus two and hexproof. Either makes Tifa a six-six, and one opponent makes her a seven-seven.

scenes.head: [[Wrecking Ball Arm]]: a 7/7 before melee
scenes.sub: Equipped creature has base power and toughness 7/7 and can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less. Equip legendary creature {3}. Melee adds on top: 10/10.
scenes.say: [[Wrecking Ball Arm]] makes her a seven-seven before melee: base power and toughness seven-seven, and creatures with power two or less can't block her. Equipping a legendary creature costs three. Melee adds on top: attack all three and she's a ten-ten.

scenes.head: [[Conqueror's Flail]]: three colors, +3/+3
scenes.sub: +1/+1 for each color among permanents you control. Tifa alone is red, green and white: a 7/7. While it's attached, opponents can't cast spells during your turn.
scenes.say: [[Conqueror's Flail]]: plus one plus one for each color among your permanents. Tifa alone is red, green and white: a seven-seven. And while it's attached, opponents can't cast spells during your turn.

scenes.head: [[Colossus Hammer]] for one mana
scenes.sub: Tap [[Sol Ring]] and cast it for {1}. An Equipment entering lets [[Puresteel Paladin]] draw you a card.
scenes.say: [[Colossus Hammer]], for one mana. Tap [[Sol Ring]] and cast it. An Equipment entering means [[Puresteel Paladin]] lets you draw a card.

scenes.head: Metalcraft: equip {0}
scenes.sub: [[Sol Ring]], [[Arcane Signet]] and the Hammer are three artifacts, so your Equipment have equip {0}. The Hammer's +10/+10 makes Tifa a 14/14.
scenes.say: Metalcraft. [[Sol Ring]], [[Arcane Signet]] and the Hammer are three artifacts, so Puresteel Paladin gives your Equipment equip zero, instead of paying the Hammer's eight. Plus ten plus ten makes Tifa a fourteen-fourteen.

scenes.head: [[Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma|Goreclaw]] turns 6 into 7
scenes.sub: Whenever Goreclaw attacks, each creature you control with power 4 or greater gets +1/+1 and trample. Nine creatures in the deck have power 6.
scenes.say: Goreclaw turns six into seven. Whenever Goreclaw attacks, each creature you control with power four or greater gets plus one plus one and trample. Nine creatures in this deck have power six.

scenes.head: [[Hero's Blade]]: a 7/6 the moment she lands
scenes.sub: +3/+2, and it attaches itself whenever a legendary creature you control enters. Tifa arrives as a 7/6 and you never pay equip {4}.
scenes.say: [[Hero's Blade]] makes her a seven-six the moment she lands. Equipped creature gets plus three plus two, and whenever a legendary creature you control enters, you may attach it to that creature. Tifa enters as a seven-six, and you never pay the equip cost of four.

scenes.head: Any creature can be the seven
scenes.sub: Tifa's trigger counts any creature you control with power 7 or greater. It checks each creature's own power, not the team's total.
scenes.say: Any creature can be the seven. Tifa's trigger counts any creature you control with power seven or greater. It checks each creature's own power, not the team's total.

scenes.head: Five are there already
scenes.sub: [[Terrian, World Tyrant|Terrian]] is a 9/7. [[Carnage Tyrant]], [[Coliseum Behemoth]], [[Savage Land Dinosaur]] and [[Saber-Tooth Moose-Lion]] have power 7.
scenes.say: Five are there already. [[Terrian, World Tyrant|Terrian]] is a nine-seven, and [[Carnage Tyrant]], [[Coliseum Behemoth]], [[Savage Land Dinosaur]] and [[Saber-Tooth Moose-Lion]] all have power seven.

scenes.head: [[Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma|Goreclaw]] makes them cheap
scenes.sub: Creature spells you cast with power 4 or greater cost {2} less. [[Terrian, World Tyrant|Terrian]] costs {2}{G}{G}{G}, so three Forests pay for it.
scenes.say: Goreclaw makes them cheap. Creature spells you cast with power four or greater cost two less. [[Terrian, World Tyrant|Terrian]] costs two generic and three green, so three Forests pay for it.

scenes.head: Early on, they find lands
scenes.sub: [[Savage Land Dinosaur]] has basic landcycling {2}. [[Saber-Tooth Moose-Lion]] and [[Balamb T-Rexaur]] have forestcycling {2}.
scenes.say: Early on, they find lands. For two mana, cycle [[Savage Land Dinosaur]] for a basic land, or [[Saber-Tooth Moose-Lion]] or [[Balamb T-Rexaur]] for a Forest.

scenes.head: Power is card draw: [[Lifestream's Blessing]]
scenes.sub: Draw X cards, where X is the greatest power among creatures you controlled as you cast it. If [[Terrian, World Tyrant|Terrian]] is your biggest, draw nine.
scenes.say: Power is card draw. [[Lifestream's Blessing]] draws X cards, where X is the greatest power among creatures you controlled as you cast it. If [[Terrian, World Tyrant|Terrian]] is your biggest, that's nine cards.

scenes.head: [[Colossal Majesty]]: a card every upkeep
scenes.sub: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card. Tifa is a 4/4 on her own.
scenes.say: [[Colossal Majesty]]. At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control a creature with power four or greater, draw a card. Tifa is a four-four on her own.

scenes.head: [[Garruk's Packleader]]: every big body draws
scenes.sub: Whenever another creature you control with power 3 or greater enters, you may draw a card. In this deck that's nearly every creature.
scenes.say: [[Garruk's Packleader]]. Whenever another creature you control with power three or greater enters, you may draw a card. In this deck, that's nearly every creature you cast.

scenes.head: [[Annie Joins Up]]
scenes.sub: If a triggered ability of a legendary creature you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time. Tifa is legendary, and both her abilities are triggers.
scenes.say: [[Annie Joins Up]]. If a triggered ability of a legendary creature you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time. Tifa is legendary, and both of her abilities are triggers.

scenes.head: It enters shooting
scenes.sub: Cast it for {1}{R}{G}{W}. When it enters, it deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls. Clear a blocker.
scenes.say: It enters shooting. Annie costs one generic, plus red, green and white. When it enters, it deals five damage to target creature or planeswalker an opponent controls. Clear a blocker.

scenes.head: …and the blocker is gone.
scenes.say: And the blocker is gone.

scenes.head: Attack all three: melee triggers twice
scenes.sub: Tifa, [[Red XIII, Proud Warrior|Red XIII]] and [[Llanowar Elves]] each attack a different opponent. Each melee trigger counts three: +3/+3, twice. Tifa is a 10/10.
scenes.say: Attack all three, and melee triggers twice. Tifa, [[Red XIII, Proud Warrior|Red Thirteen]] and [[Llanowar Elves]] each attack a different opponent. Each melee trigger counts three opponents: plus three plus three, twice. Tifa is a ten-ten.

scenes.head: She connects: her trigger fires twice
scenes.sub: Unblocked, she deals 10. Each trigger untaps all your creatures and, since this is your first combat, adds another combat phase after this one.
scenes.say: She connects, and her trigger fires twice. Unblocked, she deals ten. Each trigger untaps all your creatures, and since this is your first combat, each one adds another combat phase after this one.

scenes.head: Two extra combats: three in all
scenes.sub: Rule 500.8: if multiple extra phases are created after the same phase, the most recently created occurs first. Both happen. Only the first combat adds more.
scenes.say: Two extra combats: three in all. Rule five hundred point eight: if multiple extra phases are created after the same phase, the most recently created occurs first. Both happen, and only your first combat adds more.

scenes.head: No main phase in between
scenes.sub: Combat follows combat directly, and equip is sorcery-speed. Cast your creatures and attach Equipment before the first combat.
scenes.say: There's no main phase in between. Combat follows combat directly, and you can only equip as a sorcery. So cast your creatures and attach your Equipment before the first combat.

scenes.head: Combat two: she's a 16/16
scenes.sub: Attack all three again: melee triggers twice more. Its +1/+1s last until end of turn, so they stack: 10 plus 6 is 16.
scenes.say: Combat two, and she's a sixteen-sixteen. Attack all three again, and melee triggers twice more. Its bonuses last until end of turn, so they stack: ten plus six is sixteen.

scenes.head: [[Moonshaker Cavalry]]: the finisher
scenes.sub: When it enters, creatures you control gain flying and get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
scenes.say: [[Moonshaker Cavalry]] is the finisher. When it enters, creatures you control gain flying and get plus X plus X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.

scenes.head: Six creatures: +6/+6 each
scenes.sub: [[Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma|Goreclaw]] cuts it to {3}{W}{W}{W}. Moonshaker counts itself: six creatures, so [[Llanowar Elves]] is a 7/7 and Tifa a 10/10.
scenes.say: Six creatures, so plus six plus six each. Goreclaw cuts Moonshaker from eight mana to six. It counts itself: six creatures, so even [[Llanowar Elves]] is a seven-seven, and Tifa is a ten-ten.

scenes.head: Five flying attackers, all power 7 or more
scenes.sub: Moonshaker has no haste, so it stays home. Any attacker that connects triggers Tifa, and the bonus and flying last until end of turn, through every combat.
scenes.say: Five flying attackers, all power seven or more. Moonshaker has no haste, so it stays home. Any one that connects triggers Tifa, and the bonus and flying last until end of turn, through every combat.

scenes.head: [[Akroma's Will]]: choose both
scenes.sub: With a commander out: flying, vigilance and double strike, plus lifelink, indestructible and protection from each color. Hold it for the [[Annie Joins Up|Annie]] turn.
scenes.say: [[Akroma's Will]]. With a commander out, choose both modes: your creatures gain flying, vigilance and double strike, plus lifelink, indestructible and protection from each color. Hold it for the [[Annie Joins Up|Annie]] turn.

scenes.head: Keep the turn alive
scenes.sub: [[Heroic Intervention]]: hexproof and indestructible. [[Ultimate Magic: Holy]]: indestructible, and if you foretold it and cast it from exile, you take no damage this turn.
scenes.say: Keep the turn alive. [[Heroic Intervention]] gives your permanents hexproof and indestructible. [[Ultimate Magic: Holy]] gives them indestructible too, and if you foretold it and cast it from exile, it also prevents all damage that would be dealt to you this turn.

scenes.head: [[Rogue's Passage]]: unblockable all turn
scenes.sub: {4}, tap: target creature can't be blocked this turn. One activation covers every combat.
scenes.say: [[Rogue's Passage]]. For four mana and a tap, target creature can't be blocked this turn. One activation covers every combat.

scenes.head: 21 from your commander ends a player
scenes.sub: A player dealt 21 or more combat damage by the same commander loses (rule 903.10a). With [[Annie Joins Up|Annie]] out, unblocked Tifa hits for 10, then 16: 26.
scenes.say: Twenty-one from your commander ends a player. A player dealt twenty-one or more combat damage by the same commander loses. With [[Annie Joins Up|Annie]] out and all three attacked, an unblocked Tifa hits for ten, then sixteen: twenty-six.

scenes.head: Tifa, Martial Artist — Seventh Heaven
scenes.sub: Bracket 3 · up to three combats a turn · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Tifa, Martial Artist. Seventh Heaven. Bracket three, with up to three combats a turn. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
